repository_record_corrections.actual_upstream: each hidden block is Linear -> BatchNorm1d -> ReLU; the bottleneck Linear(2048,16) and the output Linear(2048,input_dim) have no BatchNorm and no activation

repository_record_corrections.action: corrected forms recorded in the Protocol-A config
repository_record_corrections.actual_upstream: those values correspond to the CRLF-converted bytes, not the raw file bytes

reproduction_tolerance.justification: Upstream seeds torch and the sklearn split but does not disable cuDNN nondeterminism, and its early stopping (patience 3) means a single epoch's difference changes the final weights. Run-to-run variation of a fraction of an AUC point is therefore expected even from the authors' own code, so bitwise equality is not a reasonable criterion. 0.5 points is adopted as the near-exact band and 2.0 points as the material-deviation boundary. Both were fixed before any MechaSight Protocol-A test score was computed.

upstream_verification.phase2_recorded_hash_discrepancy: The Phase-2 provenance SHA-256 values do not match the raw upstream bytes. They are reproduced exactly by the CRLF-converted form, so the Phase-2 hashes were recorded after Windows line-ending conversion. Content is identical; the recorded hash form was non-portable. Both forms and the git blob SHA-1 are now recorded.
